01-cover.html: - Observability, the 90-second tour. Everything that follows is on one platform.
02-platform-outcomes.html:
- Any data, any source, business and operational, flows into the Elastic Observability layer on top of the Elasticsearch platform.
- Six capabilities plus the AI Assistant. Runs on public cloud, hybrid or on-prem.
- Outcomes: 69% satisfaction (Elastic survey), 75% productivity and 85% less revenue disruption (Forrester TEI).
03-agentic-platform.html:
- All signals in, insights to action out.
- Three layers: AI and data platform, AI intelligence layer, agentic investigations.
- MCP apps and reusable skills let Claude, Cursor and others use all of it.
04-signals-answers.html:
- Six views of the same platform: logging, tracing, RUM, infra metrics, profiling and KPI metrics.
- You need all of them to get answers, and they live together here.
05-one-click.html:
- One click on an e-commerce site becomes a request that crosses frontend, backend and an external payment provider.
- Metrics, one trace and the logs line up automatically.
- Finish on the AI assistant: ask why checkout was slow.
06-three-ways-in.html: - One platform, three ways in: Kibana dashboards, the AI Assistant and Agent Builder, or your own chat or IDE through MCP.
07-break-down-silos.html:
- One platform for business and operational data. Logs, metrics and traces correlate in context.
- An open common data model, and one view for ITOps, DevOps, SRE and AppDev.
08-log-analytics.html:
- AI categorization turns billions of log lines into a short list with anomaly scores.
- Cross cluster search, data tiering, correlation and full text search in milliseconds.
09-apm.html:
- Distributed tracing from the latency distribution down to the slowest span.
- ML health indicators and on-demand correlations find the root cause. OpenTelemetry and native agents out of the box.
10-infrastructure-monitoring.html:
- Cloud native and 3-tier architectures in one inventory. Colour is CPU.
- 400+ integrations on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud, plus Kubernetes.
- Pivot from a hot pod straight to its logs, metrics and traces.
11-simplify-ingest.html:
- One agent for logs, metrics and traces, managed centrally with Fleet.
- Thousands of agents, one-click policy changes and upgrades. 400+ integrations, many with dashboards.
12-llm-observability.html:
- Dashboards for OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock and Google Vertex AI.
- End-to-end tracing through EDOT or third party libraries, cost per model, and visibility into prompts, responses and guardrails.
13-universal-profiling.html:
- Zero instrumentation, whole system, always on and low overhead.
- Find the hot frame, see its CO2 and dollar cost, and cut compute waste.
14-digital-experience.html:
- Track infrastructure, application and business trends. Verify user journeys proactively.
- Core web vitals and page load distribution, then trace from front end to back end. Establish SLOs, SLIs and SLAs.
15-slo-management.html: - Define SLOs and SLIs, alert on burn rate and error budget, and show them next to other KPIs in dashboards.
16-zero-config-ml.html:
- Enable anomaly detection with one click for hosts and Kubernetes pods.
- The model band shows normal. Outliers get a score, and APM correlations point to the cause. Lower MTTD and MTTR.
17-ai-assistant.html:
- Built in, not bolted on. Powered by ESRE.
- Accelerate incident management, explore problems and act, with output grounded in your own data and runbooks.
18-agents-incident-flow.html:
- Follow one incident from an SLO breach to a postmortem. An AI agent picks up each stage.
- Dashboard SLO breaches, happy path, signals, case, remediation, postmortem. Learnings feed the next runbook, and the SLO recovers.
- Illustrative flow; people stay in the loop for the decisions that matter.
